spec.goal: Have a working pomodoro timer built that helps the user work in timed focus intervals.
spec.deliverable: A pomodoro timer app that runs in the browser and can be used right away.
constraints: Must function as a pomodoro timer, counting down timed work sessions and breaks.
Must not add features, integrations or accounts beyond what a pomodoro timer needs.
No tech stack, visual style or specific interval lengths were given, so these stay open and should follow standard pomodoro conventions.
done_criteria: The timer counts down a work interval and can be started, paused and reset.
The timer switches between work sessions and breaks.
The remaining time is clearly displayed.
The timer works without errors when opened.
spec.summary: You want a pomodoro timer built that counts down focus sessions and breaks, with nothing extra added.
